text: Pecorino wheels that are still moist with whey or have cracked rinds are colonised by cheese-fly larvae, whose activity breaks down the proteins until the whole wheel turns creamy and very piquant. The paste is then scraped out and kept refrigerated in terracotta or glass jars as a spreadable cream.
